volumes.label: Calcium score
volumes.blurb: The heart-only, ECG-gated scan used for calcium scoring: 3 mm slices every 1.5 mm, 0.31 mm pixels.

volumes.label: Chest · soft tissue
volumes.blurb: Whole-chest axial slices (3 mm) with a smooth soft-tissue kernel: best for heart, vessels, mediastinum.

volumes.label: Chest · lung
volumes.blurb: Same slices, sharp lung kernel: crisp lung detail.

volumes.label: Thin lung (1.5 mm)
volumes.blurb: Thin 1.5 mm slices every 0.75 mm: the sharpest 3D detail; the 3D model was built from this.

volumes.label: Lung MIP (10 mm)
volumes.blurb: Maximum-intensity projection slabs: vessels look like branching tubes, nodules like dots.

volumes.label: AI vessel-suppressed
volumes.blurb: Riverain ClearRead CT: AI digitally erased the blood vessels so lung nodules can't hide. It found none.

volumes.label: Coronal (radiologist)
volumes.blurb: The scanner's own coronal soft-tissue reformats (4 mm), downsampled 2x for the web.

volumes.label: Sagittal (radiologist)
volumes.blurb: The scanner's own sagittal soft-tissue reformats (4 mm), downsampled 2x for the web.
